The applicant shall work with South Broward High School to adequately screen the corner of the school from the proposed development with landscaping, at the applicant's cost; 3. The applicant shall work with the City regarding swales and drainage in accordance with applicable Utilities Department requirements; 4. The applicant shall work with the City's Landscape Division to provide additional vegetation and screening on the site; and 5.
